note: Court fees are a State subject (Entry 3, State List). Parent Act: Court Fees Act, 1870 (Act 7 of 1870), Schedule I Art. 1 (ad valorem on plaint). State schedules amend it. Rates below are the max ad valorem OPENING rate with stated cap, summarised from the secondary source cited per state (accessed 2026-11-06). They are illustrative for MONEY suits only; declaratory/injunction/multiple-relief suits and later notifications differ. Verify with the court Nazir / e-filing calculator before filing.
